stations.title: Theo
stations.say: What did last week bring in?

stations.title: Theo's answers
stations.text: Totals, best sellers, money per day.

captions: At Wickhollow Candles, Theo wants to know what last week brought in.
The orders sit in a file, and Theo copies them into a sheet by hand.
You write the reports in between, in three tasks.
Now last week's orders turn into totals, best sellers and money per day.
Same orders, no Sunday copying. Theo gets his three answers.
